example.name: Invalidate cache
example.description:
The following function demonstrates how to invalidate the Dagger layer cache and force execution of subsequent pipeline steps, by introducing a volatile time variable at a specific point in the Dagger pipeline.
:::note * This is a temporary workaround until cache invalidation support is officially added to Dagger. * Changes in mounted cache volumes or secrets do not invalidate the Dagger layer cache. :::
